summary.text: Greg Miller is a Republican member of the Louisiana State Senate representing District 19, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Jefferson, Lafourche, St. Charles, and St. John the Baptist parishes. First elected in 2023, Greg Miller chairs the Judiciary A Committee and serves as Senate Parliamentarian.

paragraphs.text: The Senate page, which lists the senator as Gregory A. Miller, gives his education as DeLaSalle High School (1980), a B.A. in political science from Louisiana State University (1985), and a J.D. from the LSU Paul M. Hebert Law Center (1988).

The Senate page lists Greg Miller's committee assignments as Judiciary A (chair), Local and Municipal Affairs, Senate and Governmental Affairs, Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget, and Legislative Budgetary Control Council, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation, Jefferson Parish Legislative Delegation, Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation, and Louisiana Rural Caucus.
